name: EPSY 5641
title: Causal Inference and Measurement for Data Science
description: Principles and practice of causal inference and measurement for data scientists. Topics include: fundamentals of causal inference, establishing causal (rather than correlational) relationships -- via AB tests, controlling for confounders, and the use of panel data -- and the fundamentals of measurement. Validity and reproducibility are themes throughout the course.
requirement_description: Open to students enrolled in the M.S. Data Science program or with instructor consent. Recommended preparation: Knowledge of Introductory inferential and descriptive statistics.
